description: Exclude list for recipe search - to be used with /recipes/complexSearch endpoint

params.note_dishType: Filter results where dishTypes does NOT contain 'soup', 'stew', 'dessert', 'breakfast'

notes.paprika: Excluded as raw ingredient via excludeIngredients parameter
notes.scharfes Gericht: Mapped to excludeTags: spicy, hot, chili - Spoonacular has no direct 'spicy dish' parameter
notes.Curry: Mapped to excludeTags: curry - covers curry-based dishes and sauces
notes.Orientalisch: Mapped to excludeCuisine: middle eastern - closest Spoonacular cuisine match
notes.Asiatisch: Mapped to excludeCuisine: asian, chinese, japanese, thai, vietnamese, korean
notes.Suppen-Gerichte: Mapped to excludeDishTypes: soup, stew - post-filter results where dishTypes contains 'soup' or 'stew'
notes.Süße Hauptspeisen: Mapped to excludeTags: sweet, dessert, pancake + excludeDishTypes: dessert, breakfast + excludeTitles post-filter
